item.title: Inside Sophia Marie Patisserie: The pastry shop that has dozens lining up in Chester week after week
item.description: Dozens of customers every week are lining up outside Sophia Marie Patisserie in Chester, a business which originally began with a pregnancy craving for macarons.

item.title: Hanover Planning Commission defers vote on proposed data center project. Here's what we know about it.
item.description: The Hanover County Planning Commission voted to defer a decision on a proposed data center project Thursday night, extending the debate over development that has divided residents for months.

item.title: Small business owners push for delayed marijuana retail sales as Virginia nears legalization
item.description: As Virginia prepares to legalize retail marijuana sales as soon as November, small business owners and farmers are urging lawmakers to delay the start date.
